_comment: Fully synthetic demo inbox. Dates are written as offsets from today ({{today+N}}, optionally {{today+N|%m/%d/%Y}}) and materialized by sentineldesk.clock.render_date_tokens at load time, so this inbox never rots into a pile of expired deadlines.
